summary: scripts/check_ci_config.py now validates its own list of required variable names before checking any variable: a duplicated, empty or whitespace-only name exits 3 and the message lists the offending names (repr for blank ones), never a value. Tests were written first and the four new failing-case tests failed on the old code; the valid-list test is a declared characterization. The module docstring documents the rule and the new exit code.
